scope: Evaluate the three frozen cost-v4 lazy-certificate N100 checkpoints on the exact 30-instance common set previously used for strict insertion and 300-second SCIP incumbents.
dataset_equivalence_gate: Exact key and tensor equality between seed-regenerated data and the frozen scenario file for all 30 instances.
comparison_methods: one-thread 300-second SCIP incumbent initialized by strict insertion
stopping_rule: Evaluate all 30 instances for all three frozen checkpoints or fail closed; no retries or outcome-based exclusions.
statistics: Instance is the paired unit. Average the three training-seed outcomes within each instance, then use a paired nonparametric bootstrap over 30 instances.
claim_boundary: This is a post hoc alignment evaluation on an existing SCIP test set. It supports direct same-instance descriptive comparison, but is not a new blinded model-selection test and does not make a SCIP incumbent optimal.
